name: Parallax "Fun Kopion Skull" Energy Assault Rifle
description:
With the Parallax, VOLT offers consumers a rugged assault rifle design with features like a larger-than-average battery and a unique actuator that enables the weapon to scale up into a persistent beam as it fires.

This modified version of the original rifle showcases a printed kopion graphic across the side of the weapon and a small kopion skull adorning the muzzle.
